articles.summary: National survey examines veterans’ perspectives on career progress, financial well-being and the future of artificial intelligence A new Wells Fargo survey, conducted by Morning Consult, finds veteran respondents report stronger outcomes than non-veterans across career satisfaction, financial confidence and readiness for an AI-enabled workplace. The research also identifies a continuing challenge: nearly half of veterans say the transition from military to civilian life was difficult. Wells Fargo Military Veterans Survey graphic featuring two uniformed U.S. military service members walking outside a Wells Fargo location. The survey highlights career satisfaction, financial confidence, artificial intelligence and employer support. The online survey, conducted by Morning Consult Oct. 1–11, 2026, included 4,000 U.S. adults: 2,000 veterans and 2,000 non-veterans. Of those surveyed, veterans are more likely than non-veterans to be very satisfied with their career progress (44% vs. 32%),
articles.title: Wells Fargo Study Finds Veterans Report Greater Career Satisfaction, Financial Confidence and Optimism About AI
